records.summary: Researcher-demonstrated remote root compromise through NFS server memory corruption.
records.impact: Complete host compromise; potential loss of storage confidentiality and availability.
records.action: Identify reachable NFSv4.1/4.2 servers; restrict NFS access; install distribution-approved kernel fix and reboot.
records.hunt: Review NFS-related kernel warnings, unexpected shell processes and bursts of short sessions.
records.affected: Unpatched in-kernel NFS server with NFSv4.1/4.2 enabled and reachable
records.notes: Private working exploit demonstrated by researchers; malicious exploitation not confirmed. Urgent escalation based on impact; not a confirmed zero-day in the wild.
records.sla: Immediate assessment; target 24h for exposed systems

records.summary: Unauthenticated WFS XML injection exposes readable files and may reach internal URLs.
records.impact: Component of an unauthenticated chain from exposed WFS to administrator access and code execution as the GeoServer service account; possible geospatial data theft or alteration.
records.action: Restrict external GeoServer/WFS access; upgrade to 3.0.2 or 2.28.6 (2.27.7 fixes the unsupported 2.27 branch); investigate before restoring access and rotate exposed credentials and secrets.
records.hunt: Review WFS stored-query creation, invocation and deletion, abnormal XML errors, unexpected administrator sessions, JDBC configuration changes, uploaded files, Java child processes and outbound connections.
records.affected: Vulnerable GeoServer releases, including 3.0.1 and 2.28.5; verify exact branch ranges with project advisories.
records.notes: watchTowr honeypot exploit-validation activity reported 25 November; successful full-chain host compromise not established.
records.sla: Immediate assessment; target 24h

records.technology: Java4Shell / HotSpot Base64; PaperCut NG/MF; Netwrix Data Classification; Fusion
records.event: Downstream vendor remediation and exposure advisories
records.summary: Java4Shell has demonstrated application-specific remote code execution. PaperCut and Netwrix published fixed bundled runtimes; Lucidworks disclosed affected Fusion deployments and interim mitigation.
records.impact: Potential Java process compromise, secret disclosure and service disruption; product-specific exploitability varies.
records.action: Inventory actual bundled runtimes and CPU capabilities; upgrade PaperCut to 26.0.7 and Netwrix to 5.8.0.38; follow Lucidworks mitigation; patch JDK and restart JVMs. Where supported temporarily disable Base64 intrinsics.
records.hunt: Review JVM crashes, unusual Java child processes, outbound connections, anomalous authentication and configuration changes; preserve logs and rotate exposed secrets if compromise suspected.
records.affected: Unpatched OpenJDK 17.0.6+ and affected 21/25/27 on x86-64 AVX-512 VBMI where untrusted input reaches decoder; Oracle Java 8 Performance Pack exception. PaperCut 25.0.0-25.0.13 and 26.0.0-26.0.6 Application/Site Servers; Fusion 5.9.9+ and some earlier 5.x updated api-gateway images; Netwrix bundled JRE.
records.fixed: Oracle 17.0.21.1, 21.0.13.1, 25.0.5.1, 27.0.1.1, 8u513-perf; PaperCut 26.0.7; Netwrix 5.8.0.38. Fusion patched builds pending per Nov 24 advisory.
records.notes: CVSS v4.0 9.2 researcher rating. Active exploitation claimed in a commercial press release without supporting telemetry; not independently confirmed. RCE demonstrations are not proof of exploitation of each downstream product. PaperCut 25.x fix pending per advisory.
records.sla: 24–72 hours; immediate assessment of internet-facing identity and CI/CD
